meta.system: Dấu Việt Global — Phase 11.1 Governance, Drift Prevention & Handoff QA

scenario_tests.expected_control: Major change requires explicit RE-OPEN; implementation agent has no redesign authority.
Consumer must reference canonical registered asset; copied derivative cannot become master.
Semantic tokens must resolve to canonical package; local forks require approved exception or upstream change.
CI/release gate identifies consumer and successor migration before retirement.
Required MediaAsset classification/provenance is a data/editorial issue; frontend cannot infer it.
Ship scoped correction when necessary; document owner/risk and reconcile canonical baseline immediately after.
Platform exports derive from canonical master; generated outputs are not hand-edited.
External package must resolve to current Production-Locked registry version.
Reflow/layout correction is Patch if semantics/hierarchy stay unchanged; do not shrink below typography contract.
Signature interactions must retain static/full factual meaning under reduced motion.
Compare intended token change and affected locked surfaces; unexplained drift blocks release.
Exception cannot silently become precedent; renew with owner/risk or remove.

handoff_qa.Design→Code: PASS — canonical IDs, tokens, SVG/icon masters, state/responsive/locale/accessibility contracts
handoff_qa.CMS→Frontend: PASS WITH GATE — provenance/classification required for evidence-sensitive media
handoff_qa.Claude: PASS WITH RULE — backend/CMS/domain implementation consumes locked contracts; no UI semantic invention
handoff_qa.Codex: PASS WITH RULE — Web/mobile consumes locked assets/tokens/UX; no redesign authority
handoff_qa.Platform Exports: PASS WITH RULE — generated from masters; no manual master fork
handoff_qa.Release: PASS WITH RULE — registry snapshot, QA evidence, exceptions/deprecations and changelog required

production_rules: Canonical registry ID + version, not filename or screenshot, determines production asset identity.
Production consumers may not create or promote local derivative masters of locked logo, icon, token or motion assets.
Any change to locked geometry, semantic meaning, product hierarchy or governing principle is Major and requires explicit RE-OPEN plus impact review.
Patch corrections are permitted only when they preserve locked semantics/hierarchy and include focused QA evidence.
Deprecated assets/tokens require a named successor and consumer migration; unresolved production consumers block retirement/release as applicable.
Evidence-sensitive media missing required classification, entity relation, rights/provenance or disclosure cannot be published, and frontend inference is prohibited.
Generated platform exports are reproducible derivatives of canonical masters and are regenerated rather than manually patched.
Exceptions are registered, scoped, owned, risk-documented and time-bounded; expiry requires removal or explicit renewal review.
Critical release gates include canonical asset resolution, deprecated usage, visual regression, locale/text scaling, reduced motion and provenance/disclosure.
Emergency legal, safety, truth or accessibility fixes may bypass normal cadence but not documentation, ownership, follow-up QA or canonical reconciliation.
Claude/Codex implementation prompts and tickets identify locked baselines, canonical IDs/files, allowed changes, prohibited redesign and required QA evidence.
A release is not brand-complete until the registry/changelog reflects shipped versions and all known exceptions/deprecations are reconciled or explicitly carried.
